name: Creamy Asiago and Sun-Dried Tomato Pork Tenderloin Medallions
ingredients_verbatim: 1/2 cup baby spinach, tightly packed and chopped
why: In-band low-carb pork tenderloin skillet: published 421 cal / 39.7g protein / 4.7g carbs per serving (source's own numbers) - comfortably above the 400 floor, well under both the 650 cal and 35g carb ceilings, and the standout protein-to-calorie ratio the catalog is built on. Structurally low-carb (meat + cream + cheese + non-starchy spinach/sun-dried tomato, no starch base). Skillet, batch-scales cleanly to 14. Distinct from every existing tenderloin dish (stroganoff, tagliatelle, sheet-pan-potatoes, thai peanut, blackberry, dutch-oven roast, shogayaki, burrito bowl). Asiago is the one genuinely board-absent ingredient - flagged for the pricer lane, not dropped (parmesan is the obvious board-resident substitute if the selector prefers).
